items.computation: Payment period runs 'innerhalb von 14 Tagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum' (Rechnungsdatum = 07.09.2026). Per § 187(1) BGB, since the period begins with an event (the invoice date), that day itself is not counted; counting starts 08.09.2026. 14 days later (per § 188(1) BGB, the period ends with the expiry of the last day) falls on 21.09.2026. 2026-09-21 is a Monday and not a public holiday in NRW, so no weekend/holiday adjustment is needed.
